name: NavMeshAIController
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play wrapper around Unity's built-in NavMeshAgent — patrol/chase/flee pre-wired, so dropping this on an agent that already has a NavMeshAgent gives it real 3D navmesh movement without hand-writing any of the three behaviors. Requires an actual BAKED NavMesh in the scene (Window > AI > Navigation, or UnityEditor.AI.NavMeshBuilder.BuildNavMesh() from an editor script) — this component only consumes one, it doesn't create it.

src_serialized.name: state
src_serialized.tooltip: Which of the four pre-wired behaviors is currently active.

src_serialized.name: patrolPoints
src_serialized.tooltip: Points visited in order, looping back to the first after the last.

src_serialized.name: patrolWaitTime
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds to wait at each patrol point before moving to the next.

src_serialized.name: target
src_serialized.tooltip: The Transform to chase (State = Chase) or run away from (State = Flee).

src_serialized.name: chaseSpeed
src_serialized.tooltip: Movement speed while chasing or fleeing.

src_serialized.name: fleeDistance
src_serialized.tooltip: How far away (in a straight line) to try to flee to.

src_members.sig: public void SetState(NavMeshAIState newState) => state = newState
src_members.name: SetState

src_members.sig: public void SetTarget(Transform newTarget) => target = newTarget
src_members.name: SetTarget
